apps.name: Pomodoro
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Focus/break timer on the music screen. A card buzzes your wrist at every phase change.

apps.name: Lap Stopwatch
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Start, stop and record laps from your wrist. Laps appear in the contacts list.

apps.name: Checklist
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Packing lists, groceries, pre-flight checks. Tick items off with the media buttons; progress is saved.

apps.name: Turn by Turn
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Step through a route on your wrist. Paste directions as "instruction | distance" lines.

apps.name: Teleprompter
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Silent speaker notes. Next/prev move through your script; play scrolls it automatically.

apps.name: Tally Counter
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Count anything with a tap. The count survives restarts; set a goal to get a buzz when you hit it.

apps.name: Dice
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Roll a d4 to d100 from your wrist. History of the last 20 rolls goes into the contacts list.

apps.name: Crypto Ticker
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Shows a coin price on the weather tile and music card, refreshed every minute. Needs internet.

apps.name: Breathe
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Box breathing, 4-7-8 or your own pattern. Follow the buzzes with your eyes closed.

apps.name: Caffeine Log
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Track mg of caffeine for the day with one-tap presets. Resets at midnight; buzzes if you go over your limit.

apps.name: Countdown
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Days, hours and minutes until the things you are looking forward to. Buzzes when an event arrives.

apps.name: Decision Maker
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Can't choose? Ask the 8-Ball, flip a coin, or let it pick dinner from your list. Answers pop up as a card.

apps.name: Flashcards
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Study on the go. Flip a card with play, mark it known or not with the volume keys. Known cards drop out.

apps.name: Habit Tracker
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Tick off daily habits from your wrist and keep the streaks going. Resets each day, remembers your history.

apps.name: Hydration
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Nudges you to drink on a schedule and counts glasses towards a daily goal. Quiet hours keep nights silent.

apps.name: Interval Timer
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Work/rest rounds for HIIT, Tabata or circuits. Your wrist buzzes at every switch so you never look at a clock.

apps.name: Kitchen Timers
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Run several named timers together. Play starts the selected one; next/prev pick which timer you are editing.

apps.name: Live Weather
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Current conditions and an hourly forecast for any city, refreshed every 10 minutes. Needs internet.

apps.name: Metronome
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Practice tempo with a ticking beat on your wrist. Volume keys nudge BPM; play starts and stops the click.

apps.name: Morse Buzz
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Convert a short phrase into morse and buzz it on your wrist. Play to send; great for silent signals.

apps.name: Parking
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Save your spot and see how long you have been parked. Buzzes when a meter limit you set is almost up.

apps.name: Password Gen
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Roll a random password on your wrist. Length and symbols in settings; copy from the alert card on your phone.

apps.name: Quotes
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Inspiration on your wrist. Next and prev step through quotes; play sends the full line as a card.

apps.name: Random Walk
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Pick a random compass direction and walk that way for a block. Play rolls; next/prev change how many choices.

apps.name: Scoreboard
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Keep score for two sides from your wrist. Volume keys for home, next/prev for away. Buzzes when someone wins.

apps.name: Tip & Split
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Work out tip and per-person totals from the bill. Volume keys change tip %; next/prev change party size.

apps.name: Unit Converter
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Flip through km/mi, °C/°F, kg/lb and L/gal on your wrist. Volume keys change the value; play swaps direction.

apps.name: World Clock
apps.author: cmfkit
apps.description: Time in the cities you care about. Flick through them with next/prev; the whole list sits in contacts.
